up: Retrieve activity data for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1822. Return: assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), target type (target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Apply filters: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1822', target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606, activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Order results by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id ASC, assays.chembl_id ASC. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1822'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND td.tax_id = 9606
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  md.chembl_id ASC,
  ass.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000
